brief: The lawn's way OUT is the one leg in the garden nobody priced, and it is on frame. #168 priced the lawn's STAY at the walk home and emptied the garden accordingly, but `exitLeg` still runs from x32.5 to `laneEdge` — up to 110 cells — so a sitter who leaves at dusk reads as 28.6 sim hours of walking home across a dark town, in the wide shot, long after the garden itself has gone quiet. Price the exit the way the stay was priced, so that the courtyard empties and STAYS empty rather than trailing walkers through the night. Why now: Courtyard & garden is 7 back; c256 was raised at #166 and this is the second manager pass it has survived.
successLooksLike: Over several seeds x several days, the count of lawn people still walking after `EVE_GONE` falls to near zero, and lawn presence during the day is not reduced by more than a token amount — the fix is to the exit, not to the population. Quote both numbers before and after.
avoid: PREMISE PARTLY UNVERIFIED — the 110 cells and 28.6 h come from c256, written at #166, and #168 has changed the garden since. Re-count on HEAD before building. LAWS: price the walk where it can be PAID — at the door when the place is near, at the STAY when the crossing costs a day's light — and a return leg charged at the DOOR fails as a POPULATION going to zero, never as a slower rate, so watch for that failure mode specifically.
